name: Southland Electrical Supply, An IPS Company
about:
Southland Electrical Supply, an IPS Company, was founded in 1987 in Burlington, North Carolina, as a family-owned business built on service, people, and hard work. Over three decades it has grown to operate six locations across the Southeast.

The company maintains a 200,000-square-foot inventory of new surplus and reconditioned industrial electrical equipment, including circuit breakers, starters, contactors, renewal parts, bus plugs, disconnects, PLCs, motor control centers, and transformers. It also provides repair services for molded case breakers, air breakers, motor starters, and PLC automation equipment, backed by a 12-month warranty. Custom engineering, retrofits, and upgrades are offered alongside field service and preventative maintenance.

Southland serves industrial customers requiring electrical equipment, repairs, and custom solutions. Its client base spans facilities that rely on low- and medium-voltage power distribution and control systems, with 24/7 emergency support and courier service available.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround—average order time for molded case breakers is one to two days, and most projects are completed in one to two weeks—along with same-day and next-day shipping options. A family-business culture and certified technician staff underpin its service model.
